title: Failure Is the Mother of Success: Recovering Supervision with Grounding Hindsight
abstract: arXiv:2610.21018v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When every rollout for a problem fails, GRPO receives neither a successful exemplar nor a nonzero group-relative advantage, so it learns nothing from exactly the problems it most needs to learn. The failed reasoning can nevertheless suggest what to try next. We present Replay-Selected Hindsight Distillation (RSHD), which turns failed attempts into an additional, tested source of supervision during GRPO training. The policy writes a corrective note about each failed attempt without seeing a reference answer or solution, then re-solves the problem with the note in context. A note is admitted only if its replays succeed more often than the original group did, after screening for notes that state the answer, and an admitted replay is distilled into the plain-prompt policy. Because admission is decided by fresh successes rather than by the failed rollout itself, the procedure can recover supervision from groups in which every attempt failed,

translated_title: 失败乃成功之母：以接地式后见之明恢复监督信号
translated_abstract: 当一个问题上的所有 rollout 全部失败时，GRPO 既得不到成功范例，也无法获得非零的组相对优势，因此它恰恰在最需要学习的问题上学不到任何东西。然而，失败的推理过程仍然能够提示下一步应该尝试什么。我们提出了重放筛选式后见之明蒸馏（Replay-Selected Hindsight Distillation, RSHD），它在 GRPO 训练过程中将失败尝试转化为一种额外的、经过检验的监督来源。策略在不查看参考答案或标准解答的情况下，为每一次失败尝试撰写一条纠正性笔记，然后带着这条笔记重新解题。只有当笔记的重放成功率高于原始组、并且在筛除那些直接给出答案的笔记之后，该笔记才会被采纳；被采纳的重放随后会被蒸馏进纯提示词策略中。由于采纳与否由全新的成功表现决定，而非由失败的 rollout 本身决定，该流程能够从所有尝试均告失败的组中恢复出监督信号。
tldr: 提出 RSHD 方法，让策略为 GRPO 中的失败尝试撰写纠正性笔记并用其重解问题，仅当重放成功率超过原始组时才将笔记蒸馏回策略，从而从全组失败的难题中恢复监督信号。
en_tdlr: RSHD recovers supervision from all-failed GRPO groups by having the policy write corrective notes on failed attempts, re-solving problems with those notes, and distilling only notes whose replays outperform the original group.
